pages.markdown: Rabbit set the fourth lantern on its station beside the split oak. A gust flipped the picnic list from Wise Turtle’s route notes. Turtle held the notes close while Rabbit chased the fluttering list and caught it against a fern. “Four lights, one list,” Rabbit said. “All ready for tonight.”

Rabbit bounded ahead to check the lights, ears bobbing with every hop. Wise Turtle followed the route notes one step at a time. At the hedge gap, Rabbit peered at lantern 3, then dashed on. Turtle traced the marked stops with one claw. A cool raindrop tapped Rabbit’s nose before the check was done.

The branches groaned above the path. A hard gust rushed through the woods, and rain pattered on the leaves. Rabbit ducked beneath a fern. Wise Turtle tucked the notes under a shell flap. When the gust passed, every lantern station stood empty. The path had lost all four of its warm lights.

When the rain stopped, Rabbit shook water from both ears. The numbered stations were empty: the low log, stump, hedge gap, and split oak. Wise Turtle checked the route notes while Rabbit searched along the nearby trail. A pale glow winked beside the low log. Rabbit pointed. “There’s one!”

Rabbit scooped up lantern 1 beside the low log. “I’ll put it where everyone can see!” Without checking the notes, Rabbit carried it to the fork and set it down. Its glow pointed along the wrong branch. Lanterns 2, 3, and 4 were still missing, and the path looked more puzzling than before.

Wise Turtle stopped Rabbit from following the wrong glow. “We must inspect every station before we trust anything,” Turtle said. Rabbit looked back at lantern 1, then at the empty trail. “I moved it too fast,” Rabbit admitted. Turtle held the route notes close. The other scattered lights might be clues, if they looked first.

Beyond the hedge gap, Rabbit spotted a glow under flattened grass. Lantern 3 lay there, just past the hedge. The blades all leaned inward toward the gap. Rabbit crouched but left the lantern where it rested. “This one came through here,” Rabbit said. Wise Turtle studied the bent grass without touching it.

They followed the path past the split oak. Farther along the same line, lantern 4 glimmered among low branches. Its handle was snagged beyond the tree. Rabbit pointed from the path. “That’s farther out than the hedge light.” Wise Turtle nodded and kept the route notes tucked safely away.

Rabbit reached toward lantern 3, but Wise Turtle raised a gentle hand. “Let’s leave both lights where we found them,” Turtle said. “Then we can compare the places.” Rabbit drew back and looked from the bent grass to the branches beyond the oak. Lantern 1 still waited at the fork. Somewhere, lantern 2 was missing.

Rabbit compared the three spots at last. Lantern 1 had landed by the low log. Lantern 3 lay beyond the hedge, and lantern 4 rested still farther past the oak. From the fork, Rabbit pointed along their line. “The gust carried these outward through the gap.” Wise Turtle looked toward the stump.

Wise Turtle traced the route with one claw. “The gust may have funneled through the hedge gap,” Turtle said. “Then it could curl around the stump.” Rabbit pictured the leaves spinning there. That would send a loose lantern behind the stump, not down the open trail. The guess gave them a place to search first.

Rabbit’s paws began to bounce, then stopped. “Lantern 2 could be behind the stump,” Rabbit said. Wise Turtle checked the route notes and nodded. “We’ll search there first.” Rabbit waited for Turtle to turn before setting off. The stump stood just ahead, dark with rain and rimmed with wet leaves.

Rabbit bounded toward the stump, then paused when Wise Turtle gave their agreed hand signal. Rabbit waited until Turtle caught up. Together they looked behind the broad roots. Damp leaves covered the ground, and a twig ticked against the bark. Rabbit began lifting the leaves one at a time.

A little gold glow shone through the leaves. Rabbit brushed them aside and found lantern 2 tucked behind the stump. “Your wind guess worked!” Rabbit called. Wise Turtle came over to look. The lantern was damp, but its numbered tag was clear. All four lights had been found, though none were back in place.

Wise Turtle studied the scattered lights, then closed the route notes. “I thought I had to check every detail myself,” Turtle said. “That would take too long tonight.” Rabbit held lantern 2 carefully. “I can scout, and you can guide me.” Turtle smiled. “Let’s do both.”

They checked each numbered tag against Wise Turtle’s route notes. Lantern 1 belonged by the low log, 2 by the stump, 3 at the hedge gap, and 4 by the split oak. Rabbit read the tags aloud while Turtle matched each stop. No more guessing; they both knew where every light belonged.

“I’ll take lantern 2,” Rabbit said, lifting it from behind the stump. Wise Turtle picked up lantern 3 beneath the bent grass. They carried the lights toward their stations, then agreed to meet at the split oak. Lantern 1 stayed at the fork. Lantern 4 was still tangled beyond the oak.

Rabbit reached the stump station and set lantern 2 beside its numbered mark. Then Rabbit hurried to the split oak, remembering to look for Turtle at the meeting spot. Wise Turtle placed lantern 3 at the hedge gap station and came along the path. They met beneath the oak’s forked branches. Two lights were home.

Lantern 4’s handle was caught in thin vines beyond the split oak. Wise Turtle held the loose vines apart. Rabbit slowed both paws and eased the handle free, one loop at a time. Then Turtle carried lantern 4 toward its station. Rabbit headed back along the path to fetch lantern 1 from the fork.

Rabbit reached the fork and lifted lantern 1 from the ground. This time, Rabbit checked its tag before carrying it to the low log station. Wise Turtle had placed lantern 4 by the split oak and came back along the path. They met beside the low log. All four numbered lights were home.

Wise Turtle started to reach for the route notes, then let the paw fall. “Rabbit, can you tell whether the lights show from the fork?” Turtle asked. Rabbit looked toward the path and nodded. “I’ll check from there.” Turtle trusted the answer and walked with Rabbit, instead of inspecting each station alone.

Rabbit stood at the fork while Wise Turtle stayed beside them. From there, lantern 1 glowed near the low log. The other lights showed along the winding path, each farther on. Rabbit shaded both eyes and smiled. “They can see the way from here.” None of the lanterns needed to be moved.

“I can wave from here,” Rabbit said. “A bright, steady wave will show the path is ready.” Wise Turtle glanced toward the woodland edge, then nodded. “I trust your signal.” Rabbit planted both feet at the fork. Turtle stayed close, with the route notes tucked away.

Rabbit waved both paws high at the fork. The signal flashed against the dark trees. From the woodland edge came an answering wave. Rabbit lowered both paws and grinned at Wise Turtle. The neighbors had seen the sign. The four lanterns still marked the path, ready to guide everyone in before moonrise.

The neighbors reached the fork, where Rabbit stood beside lantern 1’s glow. Rabbit pointed down the marked path. “Follow the lights, past the stump and through the hedge gap.” Then Rabbit waited until everyone chose the right branch. Wise Turtle stood with them, while the first warm lanterns shone ahead.

Rabbit kept a lively step, but looked back often. The neighbors followed the lights together. Wise Turtle walked among them instead of going ahead to inspect alone. Near the stump, Rabbit slowed so no one had to hurry. Lantern 2 glowed at its station, and the picnic clearing lay close beyond the trees.

Lantern 3 shone at the hedge gap, and lantern 4 glowed beside the split oak. Guided by all four lights, the neighbors stepped into the picnic clearing before moonrise. Rabbit’s ears sprang up. Wise Turtle arrived beside the group, steady as ever. The first stars showed above the trees as the picnic began.

Rabbit sprang toward the picnic blanket, then turned back. “Turtle, your place is right here beside everyone.” Rabbit made room and smoothed the blanket’s corner. Wise Turtle settled beside the neighbors. “Thank you for leading us in,” Turtle said. Rabbit’s paws were still full of energy, but now they made space for a friend.

Rabbit bounced toward the basket, then paused beside Wise Turtle. “Would you like to choose the first treat?” Turtle smiled and picked a warm berry bun. Rabbit waited while Turtle took a bite. The sweet smell drifted over the blanket. Behind them, the path lights glowed softly through the trees.

The moon rose above the treetops as the picnic grew quiet. Rabbit sat beside Wise Turtle, crumbs on one paw and a happy smile on both faces. Along the woodland path, four lanterns held their places: low log, stump, hedge gap, split oak. Their glow reached the clearing, warm and steady through the night.

pages.markdown: Rabbit bounded toward the west gate, ears flying. A gust slapped the path. The first lantern swung hard on its hook. The hook bent with a squeak above the waiting neighbors. Rabbit sprang, paws outstretched. “Hold on, little light!” The lantern lurched toward the dark ferns.

Rabbit caught the lantern by its ring. Wise Turtle braced the post with both steady paws. The swinging stopped, but the hook stayed bent. “Our path has four stops,” said Wise Turtle. “Gate, stump, bridge, then clearing.” The neighbors waited close by, listening to the wind rattle the leaves.

“I’ll check the other posts!” cried Rabbit. Rabbit dashed toward the stump, leaving Wise Turtle beside the bent hook. Another gust rushed through the gate. Wise Turtle reached for the ring, but the lantern tore free and spun away. The stump lantern began to sway above the path.

Wise Turtle watched the gate lantern sail east. It dropped into fern hollow with a soft thump. “There you are,” Wise Turtle called. Rabbit hurried back from the stump path. Together they peered through the wet fronds. The lantern lay on its side, still glowing like a small, golden eye.

They had barely reached the stump when its lantern rolled away. Rabbit spotted it bumping over the path and stopping beside the willow roots. “That one rolled east, too!” Rabbit called. Wise Turtle looked from the roots toward the gate. “I saw where the first one landed,” Wise Turtle said, keeping both places in mind.

Wise Turtle began checking the dark posts, one by one. From the gate, Wise Turtle walked to the bridge, then onward to the clearing. Both posts stood empty. By the time Wise Turtle started the slow walk back, Rabbit had returned to fern hollow and waited beside the gate lantern. The neighbors stayed at the gate.

Rabbit’s paws began to tap. “I can fix one while we wait!” Rabbit lifted the gate lantern from fern hollow. Then Rabbit carried it alone to the left fork and set it down. Its warm glow made that wrong turn look inviting. Rabbit hurried back, pleased to have done something at last.

The stump lantern still lay by the willow roots. Rabbit rushed over, lifted it, and carried it to the right fork. Rabbit did not stop to check the trail. Soon one warm light pointed left, and another pointed right. The two glowing forks seemed to argue with each other in the dusk.

Rabbit returned empty-handed from the right fork as Wise Turtle reached the gate. The neighbors pointed toward the two distant lights. “Why does one lantern point left and one right?” Wise Turtle asked. Rabbit’s ears drooped. “I moved them alone. I thought any light would help.” Wise Turtle listened, then looked toward the storm-dark path.

Wise Turtle turned to Rabbit. “I saw the gate lantern land in fern hollow,” Wise Turtle said. “That hollow lies east of the gate post.” Rabbit looked back along the path. Fern tips still bent toward the hollow. “I saw the stump lantern by willow roots,” Rabbit said. They had two places to think about.

They pictured each lantern’s first home. Fern hollow sat east of the gate post. Willow roots sat east of the stump post. “Both landing places are on the east side,” Rabbit said, tracing the path in the damp dirt. Wise Turtle nodded. They had compared each landing with its own post, and both pointed the same way.

“The gusts may have pushed the loose lanterns east,” said Wise Turtle. “The bridge lantern could be beyond its post.” Wise Turtle looked at Rabbit. “Will you lead the search?” Rabbit’s paws bounced once, then settled. “Yes. I’ll look east of the bridge, and I’ll keep my eyes open.”

Rabbit led Wise Turtle to the bridge. Instead of dashing toward the nearest fork, Rabbit searched east of the bridge post. Wet leaves shone in the dim light. Wise Turtle searched beside Rabbit, lifting only the leaves they could see through. “The wind might hide it low,” Rabbit said. They looked carefully among the growth.

A golden glimmer winked inside a bramble pocket. “There!” Rabbit cried. The lantern’s handle had caught between thorny branches. Wise Turtle held the branches apart. Rabbit reached in slowly and freed the lantern. “That was a good place to look,” said Wise Turtle. Rabbit held the dusty lantern carefully.

Rabbit carried the lantern to the bridge post and hung it in place. Its glow spread across the wet boards. “The eastward guess worked,” Rabbit said. Wise Turtle nodded. Together they turned back toward the two false fork lights. Rabbit kept an eye on the trail this time, rather than running ahead to move them.

At the left fork, Rabbit reached toward the glowing lantern. Then Rabbit stopped. “This is the gate lantern,” Rabbit said, “but should I lift it yet?” Wise Turtle’s face stayed calm. Rabbit drew both paws back and waited for a check. The lantern remained where it was, lighting the wrong trail.

Wise Turtle pointed west, toward the gate post. A small leaf was carved into its wood. “That mark belongs to the gate,” Wise Turtle said. Rabbit studied the carving, then glanced at the fork. “This turn has no leaf,” Rabbit said. Rabbit left the lantern in place. They would move the false lights after finding the last one.

At the stump post, Rabbit looked for its mark before making a move. The post had a carved acorn. The right fork had none. “This lantern belongs here,” Rabbit said. “But let’s find the clearing lantern first.” Wise Turtle agreed. They left both false lights in place and turned toward the clearing, where one post was still dark.

As they left the stump, Wise Turtle glanced back toward the bridge. “That lantern landed east of its post, too,” Wise Turtle said. “The clearing lantern may be beyond the blanket.” Rabbit smiled. “Let’s search together. I’ll scan ahead and call if I see a glint. You can help free anything caught.” Wise Turtle agreed as they walked on.

At the clearing post, Wise Turtle set aside the slow, one-post-at-a-time check. “Your plan fits this search,” Wise Turtle said. Rabbit would scan east and call before touching any glint. Wise Turtle would follow and steady anything snagged. The clearing lantern was still missing. They faced the blanket together, ready to test their guess.

Rabbit swept east of the clearing post, with Wise Turtle close behind. The blanket’s corner curled in the wind. A soft clink sounded beneath it. Rabbit stopped at once. Wise Turtle stopped, too. Neither lifted the corner yet. The sound came from the blanket edge, just beyond the post, where something seemed caught underneath.

Together they eased back the curled corner. Beneath it lay the clearing lantern, dusty but whole. Its handle looped around a root at the blanket’s edge. Rabbit reached toward it, then stopped before pulling. The lantern was found, but the root held it fast. Wise Turtle leaned close to see how the handle was caught.

“Is the clearing post its home?” Rabbit asked. Wise Turtle pointed to the post beside the blanket. “Yes, that is its place.” Rabbit eased the handle off the root. No hard yank, no sudden tug. Then Rabbit lifted the lantern and held it close. Wise Turtle watched the root spring back into the damp earth.

Rabbit carried the lantern from the blanket edge to the clearing post. The handle settled onto its hook with a quiet clink. Warm light spread over the grass and blanket. Wise Turtle looked back along the path. “The last loose lantern is home,” Wise Turtle said. Two other lights still waited at the wrong forks, so they turned west together.

Rabbit and Wise Turtle retraced the path from the clearing to the west gate. The neighbors were still waiting there. Together, they followed Rabbit and Wise Turtle toward the picnic. At the fork, one lantern glowed left and another right. The neighbors stopped. “Which way?” one asked. Rabbit looked at Wise Turtle, then at the stumpward trail.

“Stay together here,” Rabbit told the neighbors. Wise Turtle remained with them at the fork. Rabbit carried the left-fork lantern west to the gate post and hung it on its hook. The carved leaf sat just beneath it. Rabbit hurried back empty-handed. The neighbors could now see the true start of the path glowing behind them.

Rabbit chose the trail toward the stump and led the neighbors. Wise Turtle lifted the stump lantern from the right fork and carried it alongside them. At the stump, Wise Turtle hung it on the post marked with an acorn. Rabbit and the neighbors gathered there. All four lanterns now shone at their proper stops.

Rabbit led the group onward from the stump, past the glowing bridge. Wise Turtle stayed beside the slower neighbors, keeping everyone together. The path smelled of wet moss and pine. Ahead, the clearing lantern shone over the blanket. Rabbit glanced back once to make sure no one had fallen behind.

They reached the clearing before moonrise. The moon still rested below the treetops. The neighbors spread the blanket while Rabbit and Wise Turtle watched the lanterns along the path. Each light marked its proper stop, from gate to stump, bridge to clearing. The storm had passed, and the picnic waited beneath the darkening trees.

Rabbit bounced toward the picnic food, then paused. Wise Turtle was still settling onto the blanket. Rabbit waited until Wise Turtle was ready. “Let’s guess what the lantern shadows look like!” Rabbit said. Wise Turtle studied a tall shape on the blanket. “A dancing carrot,” Wise Turtle guessed first. Rabbit laughed, and the neighbors joined in beneath the steady glow.
